note: Reviewed CDB90 match 22, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: HES battlefield inventory BTL39 identifies the whole battle of 1 September 1644 and both opposing field armies. The Royalist force includes a large Irish contingent, so SCOT ROY ARMY receives an inclusive local name. The existing Covenanters QID has kind unknown and is not reused. CDB casualties of 1 Royalist and 3,000 Covenanters remain attributed estimates, not independently verified totals. Identity review (attacker; original CDB90 name SCOT COV ARMY): HES identifies Elcho's complete Covenanter force. The source SCOT COV ARMY remains a local military unit; catalogue Q1138040 has kind unknown and is not implicitly reclassified. Identity review (defender; original CDB90 name SCOT ROY ARMY): CDB SCOT ROY ARMY means the complete Royalist field force. HES identifies Montrose and Mac Colla and a largely Irish centre alongside Scottish Highland and Lowland troops; the label does not limit the count to ethnic Scots.
